## 待测试功能说明（message_tool_call 与 message_image 软删除——各删除路径补充）

### 背景确认
- MessageToolCall / MessageImage 实体均带 @TableLogic(value="0", delval="1") deleted 字段
- MessageToolCallMapper.deleteByMessageIds 已是软删：`UPDATE message_tool_call SET deleted=1 WHERE message_id IN (...) AND deleted=0`
- MessageImageMapper 继承 BaseMapper，@DS("message")，delete(wrapper) 经 @TableLogic 自动转 UPDATE message_image SET deleted=1

### 变更文件
1. platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationServiceImpl.java
   - 新增注入 MessageImageMapper
   - delete（评估删除）：执行会话删除块与基准会话删除块中，在 messageToolCallMapper.deleteByMessageIds(messageIds) 之后补充 messageImageMapper.delete(LambdaQueryWrapper<MessageImage> in messageId)
   - deleteResult：同样补充 messageImageMapper.delete(in messageId)
2. platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/agent_evaluation/AgentEvaluationServiceImpl.java
   - 新增注入 MessageImageMapper；delete 关联会话删除块补充 messageImageMapper.delete(in messageId)
3. platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/session/SessionServiceImpl.java
   - 新增注入 MessageToolCallMapper/MessageImageMapper
   - deleteSession：先 messageMapper.selectList 查询会话消息得到 messageId 集合，非空时 messageToolCallMapper.deleteByMessageIds(messageIds) + messageImageMapper.delete(in messageIds)，再 messageMapper.delete；会话/工具/变量/技能软删与缓存清理逻辑保留，不递归删除子孙会话
4. platform-app/src/test/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationServiceImplTest.java
   - 新增 MessageImageMapper mock 并传入构造器（消息 MessageImageMapper 位于 messageToolCallMapper 之后）
   - DeleteResultTests：有消息用例补 verify(messageImageMapper).delete(any())，无消息用例补 never
   - 新增 DeleteTests 3 用例：delete_执行会话与基准会话均级联软删含messageImage（selectList 两次 stub，messageToolCallMapper.deleteByMessageIds 两次分别按各自 messageId 集合、messageImageMapper.delete 两次、sessionMapper.deleteById 两个会话、evaluationResultMapper.delete、evaluationMapper.deleteById）、delete_无消息时跳过消息关联软删（never deleteByMessageIds / never messageImageMapper.delete / never messageMapper.delete）、delete_评估不存在抛 EVALUATION_NOT_FOUND
5. platform-app/src/test/java/com/ghost616/platform/session/SessionServiceImplTest.java
   - 新增 MessageToolCallMapper/MessageImageMapper mock、MessageToolCall/MessageImage TableInfo 初始化
   - deleteSession 用例更新：有消息用例 stub messageMapper.selectList 返回 2 条消息并 verify deleteByMessageIds(List.of(msgIds)) + messageImageMapper.delete；各假删条件用例捕获 messageImage wrapper 断言 paramNameValuePairs 含两个 messageId；无消息用例（新增）断言 never deleteByMessageIds / never messageImageMapper.delete 但 messageMapper.delete 仍执行；会话不存在用例补 never selectList/never deleteByMessageIds/never messageImageMapper.delete；不递归删除子孙会话用例保留（messageMapper.selectList stub 空列表）

### 确认项（无需改代码）
- DefaultMessageDataProvider.rollbackToLastUserMessage：已调用 messageToolCallMapper.deleteByMessageIds（软删）+ messageImageMapper.delete（@TableLogic 自动软删），DefaultMessageDataProviderTest 已有对应断言（deleteByMessageIds(Arrays.asList(5L,6L)) 与 messageImageMapper.delete(any())）——仅确认

### 需要验证
- 编译通过（mvn -pl platform-app -am test-compile，建议 -am reactor 模式避免本地 m2 旧 agent-integration jar 问题）
- 测试类全部用例通过：EvaluationServiceImplTest（含新增 DeleteTests 3 用例与 DeleteResultTests 断言）、SessionServiceImplTest（含新增/更新的 deleteSession 用例）、DefaultMessageDataProviderTest（rollback 回归）
